s0101.literal: Yongping and Datong two circuits, Shangdu's Yunxu two prefectural offices, and the Keshik guard all reported famine; Yongping was granted fifty thousand shi of relief grain, Datong thirteen thousand shi of grain sold in relief, Yunxu Prefecture one month of relief grain, and the Keshik guard two months of relief grain.
s0101.idiomatic: Yongping and Datong two circuits, Shangdu's Yunxu two prefectural offices, and the Keshik guard all reported famine; Yongping was granted 50,000 shi of relief grain, Datong 13,000 shi of grain sold in relief, Yunxu Prefecture 1 month of relief grain, and the Keshik guard 2 months of relief grain.

s0102.literal: In Zhending's Pingshan County, Hejian's Linjin and other counties, and Daming's Wei County, worms ate the mulberry leaves until none remained, then the worms all died.
s0102.idiomatic: In Zhending's Pingshan County, Hejian's Linjin and other counties, and Daming's Wei County, worms ate the mulberry leaves until none remained, then the worms all died.

s0103.literal: Third month, xinyou day, Yan Temür was dispatched to present the imperial seal at Mingzong's traveling encampment; privy council administrator Toghan Taimur, censor-in-chief Bajir, Hanlin regular academician Makha Mou, seals commissioner Jiaohuade, Xuanhui deputy commissioner Zhangji, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Tuoyin, Bureau of Transmission commissioner Nohai, chief imperial physician Lü Tingyu, supervisory censor Yaolü, central secretariat adjudication official Qur Qudaqa, right department director Boliechu, left department vice director Wang Deming, Ministry of Rites minister Barqaqa, and others were ordered to accompany him.
s0103.idiomatic: Third month, xinyou day, Yan Temür was dispatched to present the imperial seal at Mingzong's traveling encampment; privy council administrator Toghan Taimur, censor-in-chief Bajir, Hanlin regular academician Makha Mou, seals commissioner Jiaohuade, Xuanhui deputy commissioner Zhangji, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Tuoyin, Bureau of Transmission commissioner Nohai, chief imperial physician Lü Tingyu, supervisory censor Yaolü, central secretariat adjudication official Qur Qudaqa, right department director Boliechu, left department vice director Wang Deming, Ministry of Rites minister Barqaqa, and others were ordered to accompany him.

s0104.literal: The relevant offices were again ordered to present one thousand five hundred taels of gold, seven thousand five hundred taels of silver, four hundred bolts each of silks and cloth, and twenty gold belts to the traveling encampment for distribution as gifts.
s0104.idiomatic: The relevant offices were again ordered to present 1,500 taels of gold, 7,500 taels of silver, 400 bolts each of silks and cloth, and 20 gold belts to the traveling encampment for distribution as gifts.

s0105.literal: The Emperor commanded the court ministers: "Now that the imperial seal has gone north, on all state affairs hereafter you should dispatch men to report to the traveling encampment.
s0105.idiomatic: The Emperor commanded the court ministers: "Now that the imperial seal has gone north, on all state affairs hereafter you should dispatch men to report to the traveling encampment.

s0106.literal: " On guihai day the relevant offices were ordered to make imperial carriages and apparel to welcome the grand procession from the north.
s0106.idiomatic: " On guihai day the relevant offices were ordered to make imperial carriages and apparel to welcome the grand procession from the north.

s0107.literal: The names of routes favored by the latent residence were changed: Jiankang to Jiqing, Jiangling to Zhongxing, Qiongzhou to Qianning, and Tanzhou to Tianlin.
s0107.idiomatic: The names of routes favored by the latent residence were changed: Jiankang to Jiqing, Jiangling to Zhongxing, Qiongzhou to Qianning, and Tanzhou to Tianlin.

s0108.literal: On jiazi day the price for sheep at the Imperial Kitchen was reduced.
s0108.idiomatic: On jiazi day the price for sheep at the Imperial Kitchen was reduced.

s0109.literal: On bingyin day Yueli Temür returned from the traveling encampment with an instruction that said: "When I am at Shangdu, the princes and great ministers will certainly all assemble; the relevant offices should prepare supplies.
s0109.idiomatic: On bingyin day Yueli Temür returned from the traveling encampment with an instruction that said: "When I am at Shangdu, the princes and great ministers will certainly all assemble; the relevant offices should prepare supplies.

s0110.literal: Shangdu's accumulated stores have already been exhausted by Dawlat Shah; the Dadu treasury, I hear, is likewise entirely depleted.
s0110.idiomatic: Shangdu's accumulated stores have already been exhausted by Dawlat Shah; the Dadu treasury, I hear, is likewise entirely depleted.

s0111.literal: If supplies should prove insufficient, let what is stored in the Censorate, Ministry of Revenue, Privy Council, Xuanhui, Xuanzheng, and other offices be used to make up the shortfall.
s0111.idiomatic: If supplies should prove insufficient, let what is stored in the Censorate, Ministry of Revenue, Privy Council, Xuanhui, Xuanzheng, and other offices be used to make up the shortfall.

s0112.literal: " Mongol famine refugees gathered at the capital were sent north of Juyong Pass; each person was given one ingot of notes and one bolt of cloth; Xinghe Route was still ordered to grant two months' relief grain, then they were sent back to their homes.
s0112.idiomatic: " Mongol famine refugees gathered at the capital were sent north of Juyong Pass; each person was given 1 ingot of notes and 1 bolt of cloth; Xinghe Route was still ordered to grant 2 months' relief grain, then they were sent back to their homes.

s0113.literal: On wuchen day Yunnan princes Tash Buqa and Tuqian Buqa and grand councillor Masqu and others gathered fifty thousand men, charged grand councillor Yelzhini with ten counts of usurpation of authority, and intended to kill him.
s0113.idiomatic: On wuchen day Yunnan princes Tash Buqa and Tuqian Buqa and grand councillor Masqu and others gathered 50,000 men, charged grand councillor Yelzhini with 10 counts of usurpation of authority, and intended to kill him.

s0114.literal: Yelzhini fled to the Eight Tribes; Tash Buqa and others falsely appointed acting associate administrators and other officials.
s0114.idiomatic: Yelzhini fled to the Eight Tribes; Tash Buqa and others falsely appointed acting associate administrators and other officials.

s0115.literal: On jisi day orders were issued to remodel the Jiqing latent residence and build the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple, construction to begin the following year.
s0115.idiomatic: On jisi day orders were issued to remodel the Jiqing latent residence and build the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple, construction to begin the following year.

s0116.literal: On xinwei day censorial officials together with jarquchi and other officers recorded prisoners.
s0116.idiomatic: On xinwei day censorial officials together with jarquchi and other officers recorded prisoners.

s0117.literal: On renshen day, because there had been no snow the previous winter and no rain this spring, the central secretariat and hundred offices' officials were ordered to pray separately at mountains, rivers, and all shrines.
s0117.idiomatic: On renshen day, because there had been no snow the previous winter and no rain this spring, the central secretariat and hundred offices' officials were ordered to pray separately at mountains, rivers, and all shrines.

s0118.literal: Two lecture officers of the Kuizhang Pavilion were established, rank seventh grade, for sons and grandsons of meritorious families, noble kinsmen, and young attendants to pursue their studies.
s0118.idiomatic: Two lecture officers of the Kuizhang Pavilion were established, rank seventh grade, for sons and grandsons of meritorious families, noble kinsmen, and young attendants to pursue their studies.

s0119.literal: On jiaxu day a former grant to Duljin Temür of one hundred qing of Pingjiang land — the authorities had collected the rent rice — an edict specially granted it to him.
s0119.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a former grant to Duljin Temür of 100 qing of Pingjiang land — the authorities had collected the rent rice — an edict specially granted it to him.

s0120.literal: The Liaoyang wine prohibition was lifted.
s0120.idiomatic: The Liaoyang wine prohibition was lifted.

s0121.literal: On yihai day a mobile privy council was established; Shandong commander of ten-thousands Yesu Taier was made to administer mobile privy council affairs, and together with Huguang and Henan two branch secretariat officials was to advance troops to pacify Sichuan; Yesu Taier did not go due to illness.
s0121.idiomatic: On yihai day a mobile privy council was established; Shandong commander of ten-thousands Yesu Taier was made to administer mobile privy council affairs, and together with Huguang and Henan two branch secretariat officials was to advance troops to pacify Sichuan; Yesu Taier did not go due to illness.

s0122.literal: Mingli Dong'a was ordered to establish a shrine for the Mongol shaman-priest.
s0122.idiomatic: Mingli Dong'a was ordered to establish a shrine for the Mongol shaman-priest.

s0123.literal: On dingchou day the monthly offering at the spirit hall of Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng — a special order was issued to follow the precedent for the successive emperors.
s0123.idiomatic: On dingchou day the monthly offering at the spirit hall of Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng — a special order was issued to follow the precedent for the successive emperors.

s0124.literal: Monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, Manichaeans, and Muslims engaged in trade were still subject to tax under the old regulations.
s0124.idiomatic: Monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, Manichaeans, and Muslims engaged in trade were still subject to tax under the old regulations.

s0125.literal: On bingxu day Budasijian and others dispatched by Nangjiatai to guard the pass defenses at Diaomen submitted to the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
s0125.idiomatic: On bingxu day Budasijian and others dispatched by Nangjiatai to guard the pass defenses at Diaomen submitted to the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

s0126.literal: On dinghai day dust fell from the sky; there was haze.
s0126.idiomatic: On dinghai day dust fell from the sky; there was haze.

s0127.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou day — seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0127.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jichou day — seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0128.literal: On xinmao day Yueli Temür and Wang Bulanjidai were ordered to replace Yesu Taier in campaigning against Sichuan; Bulanjidai declined on grounds of his mother's age; associate privy council administrator Fu Yan volunteered to go — this was granted.
s0128.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yueli Temür and Wang Bulanjidai were ordered to replace Yesu Taier in campaigning against Sichuan; Bulanjidai declined on grounds of his mother's age; associate privy council administrator Fu Yan volunteered to go — this was granted.

s0129.literal: On renchen day artisan officials aged seventy were permitted to retire from office.
s0129.idiomatic: On renchen day artisan officials aged seventy were permitted to retire from office.

s0130.literal: The Tongyun Canal at Hua Prefecture was dredged.
s0130.idiomatic: The Tongyun Canal at Hua Prefecture was dredged.

s0131.literal: On jiawu day each of the four palace guard corps assigned fifty men for duty at the Eastern Palace.
s0131.idiomatic: On jiawu day each of the four palace guard corps assigned 50 men for duty at the Eastern Palace.

s0132.literal: On dingyou day ten thousand ingots of notes were granted as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple at Jiqing.
s0132.idiomatic: On dingyou day 10,000 ingots of notes were granted as perpetual endowment for the Great Longxiang Jiqing Temple at Jiqing.

s0133.literal: On wuxu day, because Shaanxi had long suffered drought, envoys were dispatched to pray at Mount Hua, the Western Peak, and other shrines.
s0133.idiomatic: On wuxu day, because Shaanxi had long suffered drought, envoys were dispatched to pray at Mount Hua, the Western Peak, and other shrines.

s0134.literal: Thirteen thousand guard soldiers were granted notes — eighty ingots per man.
s0134.idiomatic: 13,000 guard soldiers were granted notes — 80 ingots per man.

s0135.literal: The four palace guard corps had formerly been reckoned at ten thousand men; at this time three thousand were added.
s0135.idiomatic: The four palace guard corps had formerly been reckoned at 10,000 men; at this time 3,000 were added.

s0136.literal: On jihai day Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Boluo arrived in Sichuan by imperial command, pardoned Nangjiatai and others of their crimes; Nangjiatai and others obeyed the edict; Shu territory was entirely pacified; troops from all branch secretariats were dismissed.
s0136.idiomatic: On jihai day Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Boluo arrived in Sichuan by imperial command, pardoned Nangjiatai and others of their crimes; Nangjiatai and others obeyed the edict; Shu territory was entirely pacified; troops from all branch secretariats were dismissed.

s0137.literal: On guimao day Mingzong dispatched Prince Wuning Chechequ and central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu to bestow the imperial mandate, installing the Emperor as crown prince; orders were issued to reestablish the Crown Prince's Household and abolish the Office of Stored Blessings.
s0137.idiomatic: On guimao day Mingzong dispatched Prince Wuning Chechequ and central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu to bestow the imperial mandate, installing the Emperor as crown prince; orders were issued to reestablish the Crown Prince's Household and abolish the Office of Stored Blessings.

s0138.literal: One million two hundred thirty-four thousand plus persons among famine victims in Shaanxi routes; additionally several hundred thousand drifting refugees in various counties — relief had formerly been granted but proved insufficient;
s0138.idiomatic: 1,234,000 plus persons among famine victims in Shaanxi routes; additionally several hundred thousand drifting refugees in various counties — relief had formerly been granted but proved insufficient;

s0139.literal: the branch secretariat again requested ordering merchants to submit grain in exchange for salt vouchers, wealthy families to submit grain in exchange for official appointments, and issuing eighty thousand shi from the Mengjin granary and official rent stored by Henan and Hanzhong surveillance commissions for relief — this was granted.
s0139.idiomatic: the branch secretariat again requested ordering merchants to submit grain in exchange for salt vouchers, wealthy families to submit grain in exchange for official appointments, and issuing 80,000 shi from the Mengjin granary and official rent stored by Henan and Hanzhong surveillance commissions for relief — this was granted.

s0140.literal: De'an Prefecture military colonies suffered famine; one thousand shi of relief grain was granted.
s0140.idiomatic: De'an Prefecture military colonies suffered famine; 1,000 shi of relief grain was granted.

s0141.literal: Changde, Lizhou, and Cili Prefecture suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain sold in relief was granted.
s0141.idiomatic: Changde, Lizhou, and Cili Prefecture suffered famine; 10,000 shi of grain sold in relief was granted.

s0142.literal: Twelve thousand five hundred plus households of famine victims in Weihui Route were granted relief.
s0142.idiomatic: 12,500 plus households of famine victims in Weihui Route were granted relief.

s0143.literal: On bingwu day Bolad Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Zhennan.
s0143.idiomatic: On bingwu day Bolad Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Zhennan.

s0144.literal: The state of Zhanla came to court to present eaglewood, elephants, leopards, and white gibbons.
s0144.idiomatic: The state of Zhanla came to court to present eaglewood, elephants, leopards, and white gibbons.

s0145.literal: The Hanlin and Imperial Seals two academies were warned that their officials were forbidden to petition one another for seal documents to protect their households.
s0145.idiomatic: The Hanlin and Imperial Seals two academies were warned that their officials were forbidden to petition one another for seal documents to protect their households.

s0146.literal: When darughachi of princes' allotted domains were relieved, they were not permitted to remain at their posts; where a father or elder brother held office, sons and younger brothers were not permitted to hold it again.
s0146.idiomatic: When darughachi of princes' allotted domains were relieved, they were not permitted to remain at their posts; where a father or elder brother held office, sons and younger brothers were not permitted to hold it again.

s0147.literal: On xinhai day three thousand six hundred shi of grain tax was granted in relief to war-fleeing households in various counties of Deng Prefecture.
s0147.idiomatic: On xinhai day 3,600 shi of grain tax was granted in relief to war-fleeing households in various counties of Deng Prefecture.

s0148.literal: On renzi day two months' grain relief was granted to war-afflicted people in various counties of Tong Prefecture; four thousand five hundred ten captured persons were ordered escorted home by the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat through its subordinates' registers.
s0148.idiomatic: On renzi day 2 months' grain relief was granted to war-afflicted people in various counties of Tong Prefecture; 4,510 captured persons were ordered escorted home by the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat through its subordinates' registers.

s0149.literal: On bingchen day Jirhalang and others dispatched from the traveling encampment reached the capital.
s0149.idiomatic: On bingchen day Jirhalang and others dispatched from the traveling encampment reached the capital.

s0150.literal: Henan Surveillance Commission reported: "In Henan Prefecture Route, because of warfare and drought the people suffered famine; fifty-one cases of eating human flesh came to light; one thousand nine hundred fifty died of starvation; more than seventeen thousand four hundred suffered famine.
s0150.idiomatic: Henan Surveillance Commission reported: "In Henan Prefecture Route, because of warfare and drought the people suffered famine; 51 cases of eating human flesh came to light; 1,950 died of starvation; more than 17,400 suffered famine.

s0151.literal: We request relaxing prohibitions on mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes to allow the people to gather wild foods, implementing the order for submitting grain in exchange for official appointments, and requisitioning surplus grain from Jiang-Huai monks and Daoists for relief.
s0151.idiomatic: We request relaxing prohibitions on mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes to allow the people to gather wild foods, implementing the order for submitting grain in exchange for official appointments, and requisitioning surplus grain from Jiang-Huai monks and Daoists for relief.

s0153.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: "Chizhou, Guangde, Ningguo, Taiping, Jiankang, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Huzhou, Qingyuan routes and Jiangyin Prefecture — more than six hundred thousand famine households; relief grain of more than one hundred forty-three thousand shi is needed.
s0153.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: "Chizhou, Guangde, Ningguo, Taiping, Jiankang, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Huzhou, Qingyuan routes and Jiangyin Prefecture — more than 600,000 famine households; relief grain of more than 143,000 shi is needed.

s0155.literal: Prince Huqadai'er reported that within his domain west of the Yellow River drought and locusts afflicted one thousand five hundred households; two months' relief grain was ordered.
s0155.idiomatic: Prince Huqadai'er reported that within his domain west of the Yellow River drought and locusts afflicted 1,500 households; 2 months' relief grain was ordered.

s0156.literal: Dadu, Xinghe, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, Huaiqing, Weihui, Bianliang, Zhongxing routes and Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Guan, Xu, and Pi prefectures — six hundred seventy-six thousand plus famine households — relief was granted in ninety thousand ingots of notes and fifteen thousand shi of grain.
s0156.idiomatic: Dadu, Xinghe, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, Huaiqing, Weihui, Bianliang, Zhongxing routes and Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Guan, Xu, and Pi prefectures — 676,000 plus famine households — relief was granted in 90,000 ingots of notes and 15,000 shi of grain.

s0157.literal: Dadu's Wanping County, Baoding's Sui and Yi Prefectures — one month of relief grain; Jing Prefecture — nine thousand eight hundred shi of grain sold in relief.
s0157.idiomatic: Dadu's Wanping County, Baoding's Sui and Yi Prefectures — 1 month of relief grain; Jing Prefecture — 9,800 shi of grain sold in relief.

s0158.literal: Puzhou's Juancheng County suffered silkworm disaster; Daning's Xingzhong Prefecture, Huaiqing's Meng Prefecture, and Luzhou's Wuwei Prefecture suffered locusts.
s0158.idiomatic: Puzhou's Juancheng County suffered silkworm disaster; Daning's Xingzhong Prefecture, Huaiqing's Meng Prefecture, and Luzhou's Wuwei Prefecture suffered locusts.

s0160.literal: Fifth month, dingsi day, first of month — an additional grant of twenty thousand ingots of notes was made to the Grand Princess of Lu to build a residence.
s0160.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi day, first of month — an additional grant of 20,000 ingots of notes was made to the Grand Princess of Lu to build a residence.

s0161.literal: An inscription for Yan Temür's grandfather's stele recording meritorious service was granted.
s0161.idiomatic: An inscription for Yan Temür's grandfather's stele recording meritorious service was granted.

s0162.literal: Shuidada Route's Asu Gur thousand-household office suffered great flood.
s0162.idiomatic: Shuidada Route's Asu Gur thousand-household office suffered great flood.

s0163.literal: On jiwei day Hanlin academician-director Alin Temür was dispatched north to welcome the grand procession.
s0163.idiomatic: On jiwei day Hanlin academician-director Alin Temür was dispatched north to welcome the grand procession.

s0164.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
s0164.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

s0165.literal: Prince of Chang Balasiri returned to his fief.
s0165.idiomatic: Prince of Chang Balasiri returned to his fief.

s0166.literal: On gengshen day Venus intruded upon the ghost constellation's piled-corpse nebula.
s0166.idiomatic: On gengshen day Venus intruded upon the ghost constellation's piled-corpse nebula.

s0167.literal: On guihai day Hanlin academician-director Orda was again dispatched to welcome the grand procession.
s0167.idiomatic: On guihai day Hanlin academician-director Orda was again dispatched to welcome the grand procession.

s0168.literal: On yichou day the relevant offices were ordered to supply clothing, grain, and horse fodder to guard soldiers at the traveling encampment.
s0168.idiomatic: On yichou day the relevant offices were ordered to supply clothing, grain, and horse fodder to guard soldiers at the traveling encampment.

s0169.literal: Thirty ingots of gold and one hundred ingots of silver from the Office of Stored Blessings were used to build the Great Chengtian Husheng Temple.
s0169.idiomatic: 30 ingots of gold and 100 ingots of silver from the Office of Stored Blessings were used to build the Great Chengtian Husheng Temple.

s0170.literal: Notes were granted to one thousand crown prince guard soldiers; the four palace guard corps, increased to thirteen thousand, were at this time increased by another thousand.
s0170.idiomatic: Notes were granted to 1,000 crown prince guard soldiers; the four palace guard corps, increased to 13,000, were at this time increased by another 1,000.

s0171.literal: On jiaxu day central secretariat officials were ordered to draft appointments for the six departments of the central secretariat and report to the traveling encampment.
s0171.idiomatic: On jiaxu day central secretariat officials were ordered to draft appointments for the six departments of the central secretariat and report to the traveling encampment.

s0172.literal: On yihai day he visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, performed Buddhist rites at Shizu's spirit hall, and again performed Buddhist rites at the Jade Virtue Hall and Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple.
s0172.idiomatic: On yihai day he visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, performed Buddhist rites at Shizu's spirit hall, and again performed Buddhist rites at the Jade Virtue Hall and Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple.

s0173.literal: On bingzi day Prince Wuning Chechequ and central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu arrived from the traveling encampment, conveying the order to install the crown prince.
s0173.idiomatic: On bingzi day Prince Wuning Chechequ and central secretariat grand councillor Qabarqu arrived from the traveling encampment, conveying the order to install the crown prince.

s0174.literal: Chechequ was granted five hundred taels of gold; the rest received varying amounts.
s0174.idiomatic: Chechequ was granted 500 taels of gold; the rest received varying amounts.

s0175.literal: The Office of Stored Blessings was changed to the Crown Prince's Household.
s0175.idiomatic: The Office of Stored Blessings was changed to the Crown Prince's Household.

s0176.literal: Bayan, Temür Buqa, Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Arslan Qaya, and Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cao Li were all made crown prince commissioners;
s0176.idiomatic: Bayan, Temür Buqa, Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief Arslan Qaya, and Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Cao Li were all made crown prince commissioners;

s0177.literal: additionally vice commissioners of the crown prince's household, crown prince commissioners' assistants, adjudication officials, Household Administration, Treasures, Expenditures, Medical, and other offices were appointed.
s0177.idiomatic: additionally vice commissioners of the crown prince's household, crown prince commissioners' assistants, adjudication officials, Household Administration, Treasures, Expenditures, Medical, and other offices were appointed.

s0178.literal: On dingchou day the Emperor departed the capital to go north and welcome Emperor Mingzong.
s0178.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Emperor departed the capital to go north and welcome Emperor Mingzong.

s0179.literal: On wuyin day he halted at Dagu.
s0179.idiomatic: On wuyin day he halted at Dagu.

s0180.literal: Prince Dingba was summoned to court.
s0180.idiomatic: Prince Dingba was summoned to court.

s0181.literal: On gengchen day he halted at Xiangshui Garden.
s0181.idiomatic: On gengchen day he halted at Xiangshui Garden.

s0182.literal: The Jiang-Huai Finance General Commissionerate was established, rank third grade, subordinate to the Crown Prince's Household.
s0182.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai Finance General Commissionerate was established, rank third grade, subordinate to the Crown Prince's Household.

s0183.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported: "In Fengxiang Prefecture one hundred ninety-seven thousand nine hundred famine persons — the branch secretariat on emergency authority granted fifteen thousand ingots of official notes for relief.
s0183.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported: "In Fengxiang Prefecture 197,900 famine persons — the branch secretariat on emergency authority granted 15,000 ingots of official notes for relief.

s0184.literal: Moreover, at the eight Fengle military colonies six hundred fifty soldiers died of famine; at the wanhu office one thousand three hundred soldiers suffered famine — one hundred thirty ingots of official notes were granted in relief.
s0184.idiomatic: Moreover, at the eight Fengle military colonies 650 soldiers died of famine; at the wanhu office 1,300 soldiers suffered famine — 130 ingots of official notes were granted in relief.

s0186.literal: Horses and carts were supplied to Dingxing Station in Baoding Route; war-afflicted people — one hundred forty-five households — were also granted one month of grain relief; in Zhending Route two thousand seven hundred forty-eight war-afflicted households were likewise ordered granted relief.
s0186.idiomatic: Horses and carts were supplied to Dingxing Station in Baoding Route; war-afflicted people — 145 households — were also granted 1 month of grain relief; in Zhending Route 2,748 war-afflicted households were likewise ordered granted relief.

s0187.literal: Guard soldiers at Shangdu's Diezhi various residences and war-afflicted people of Kaiping County were all granted grain relief.
s0187.idiomatic: Guard soldiers at Shangdu's Diezhi various residences and war-afflicted people of Kaiping County were all granted grain relief.

s0189.literal: Sixth month, dinghai day, first of month — Mingzong dispatched attendants Maju, Tatai, and Buyan Buqa.
s0189.idiomatic: Sixth month, dinghai day, first of month — Mingzong dispatched attendants Maju, Tatai, and Buyan Buqa.

s0190.literal: On dingyou day Temür Buqa requested to step down from the chancellorship on account of drought; an instruction addressed him: "The Emperor dwells far in the desert and cannot yet soon reach the capital; therefore We have reluctantly assumed the great position.
s0190.idiomatic: On dingyou day Temür Buqa requested to step down from the chancellorship on account of drought; an instruction addressed him: "The Emperor dwells far in the desert and cannot yet soon reach the capital; therefore We have reluctantly assumed the great position.

s0191.literal: Now the excessive yang produces disaster — all are caused by Our faults and failings.
s0191.idiomatic: Now the excessive yang produces disaster — all are caused by Our faults and failings.

s0192.literal: Do your utmost to fulfill your duties and reverently carry out solid governance — thereby you may respond above to Heaven's changes.
s0192.idiomatic: Do your utmost to fulfill your duties and reverently carry out solid governance — thereby you may respond above to Heaven's changes.

s0193.literal: " Orders were still issued to report swiftly to the traveling encampment.
s0193.idiomatic: " Orders were still issued to report swiftly to the traveling encampment.

s0194.literal: On jihai day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: in Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, and Wuzhou routes — one hundred eighteen thousand ninety famine households in total.
s0194.idiomatic: On jihai day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: in Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, and Wuzhou routes — 118,090 famine households in total.

s0195.literal: On yisi day the central secretariat was ordered to arrest and bring back Yesianie.
s0195.idiomatic: On yisi day the central secretariat was ordered to arrest and bring back Yesianie.

s0196.literal: On bingwu day a violent wind and sudden rain at Changguo and other colonies under Yongping Military Colony Prefecture produced water on level ground.
s0196.idiomatic: On bingwu day a violent wind and sudden rain at Changguo and other colonies under Yongping Military Colony Prefecture produced water on level ground.

s0197.literal: On dingwei day Venus was visible in the day.
s0197.idiomatic: On dingwei day Venus was visible in the day.

s0198.literal: On gengxu day he halted at the Sixty-Li Inn on the Shangdu road.
s0198.idiomatic: On gengxu day he halted at the Sixty-Li Inn on the Shangdu road.

s0199.literal: On xinhai day Shaanxi Branch Censor Kong Sidi said: "Among human relations, the bond between husband and wife is weighty.
s0199.idiomatic: On xinhai day Shaanxi Branch Censor Kong Sidi said: "Among human relations, the bond between husband and wife is weighty.

s0200.literal: Recently I have seen that when great ministers within and without the court were convicted and executed, their wives and concubines were immediately handed over to others — this seems incompatible with the dynasty's purpose in honoring chaste wives and contrary to the edict requiring lifelong mourning upon a husband's death.
s0200.idiomatic: Recently I have seen that when great ministers within and without the court were convicted and executed, their wives and concubines were immediately handed over to others — this seems incompatible with the dynasty's purpose in honoring chaste wives and contrary to the edict requiring lifelong mourning upon a husband's death.
